AI Analyst — configuration

Groq (recommended): free, hosted, works immediately — no software to install. Get a free key at console.groq.com/keys, paste it above, then click Save Config. Any other OpenAI-compatible endpoint works too.
Ollama (private alternative): 100% on-device, nothing leaves this computer, but requires installing software first. Install from ollama.com, then run ollama pull llama3.2. For the browser to reach it, start it with CORS open: OLLAMA_ORIGINS="*" ollama serve (Mac: run launchctl setenv OLLAMA_ORIGINS "*" once, then restart Ollama).
